core.evidence: Which of the following concepts best explains why one negative experience created such a lasting taste aversion?

supporting.name: Taste aversion
supporting.evidence: she got a terrible stomachache and spent the night vomiting. Since then, even thinking about pizza with black olives has made Janelle feel nauseated

confusables.name: Extinction
confusables.reason: Extinction is a classical conditioning concept about weakening a conditioned response, tempting because the scenario involves conditioning, but it describes unlearning rather than why the aversion formed so strongly.

confusables.name: Generalization
confusables.reason: Stimulus generalization is a classical conditioning concept about responding to similar stimuli, tempting because the aversion involves a learned association, but it does not explain the biological readiness for taste aversion.

core.name: Thalamus
core.evidence: What part of his brain first processed the incoming sensation before rerouting it to the correct area in the cortex

confusables.name: Broca’s area
confusables.reason: Broca's area is a named cortical area, tempting as a brain region, but it controls speech muscles rather than sensory relay.

confusables.name: Hippocampus
confusables.reason: Hippocampus is a nearby limbic-system structure, tempting as a brain structure involved in processing incoming information, but it handles memory encoding, not sensory relay.

confusables.name: Hypothalamus
confusables.reason: Hypothalamus is another limbic-system structure often grouped with the thalamus, tempting by name similarity, but it regulates metabolic functions rather than relaying sensory signals.

core.name: Experiment
core.evidence: The participants were randomly assigned to one of two conditions.

confusables.name: Case study method
confusables.reason: Case study is a non-experimental method focused on one participant or small group; tempting as a research method label but does not involve manipulation or random assignment.

confusables.name: Meta-analysis
confusables.reason: Meta-analysis is a statistical method combining many studies; tempting as a research method but not used here since this is a single primary study.

confusables.name: Naturalistic observation
confusables.reason: Naturalistic observation is another non-experimental research method; tempting because the study involves observing helping behavior, but it lacks manipulation and random assignment.

core.name: Dependent variable
core.evidence: The researchers recorded the number of participants who offered to help.

confusables.name: Independent variable
confusables.reason: Whether the email addresses were visible is the manipulated factor, so it is the independent variable rather than the dependent variable.

confusables.name: Just-world phenomenon
confusables.reason: Just-world phenomenon is another social psychological attribution concept, tempting as a social-psychology label but unrelated to group size and helping.

core.name: Systematic desensitization
core.evidence: His therapist recommends that he begin therapy by first watching videos of airplanes taking off and landing. After a few sessions, he progresses to sitting in a stationary plane at the airport, then gradually works up to booking a short flight.
